mapper.update: UPDATE mail_delivery d SET state=CASE WHEN state='SENDING' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'CANCELLED' END,error_code=CASE WHEN state='SENDING' THEN 'LEASE_RESULT_UNKNOWN' ELSE 'CHALLENGE_INVALID' END WHERE (state='SENDING' AND leased_at < now()-interval '30 seconds') OR (state IN ('PENDING','RETRYABLE_FAILED') AND (expires_at <= now() OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_challenge c LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.id=c.user_id WHERE c.id=d.challenge_id AND c.consumed_at IS NULL AND c.eligible AND c.failed_attempts < 5 AND c.expires_at>now() AND (c.user_id IS NULL OR (u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.credential_version=c.credential_version)))))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mail_delivery WHERE state IN ('PENDING','RETRYABLE_FAILED') AND next_attempt_at <= now() AND expires_at>now() AND attempts < 3 ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE mail_delivery SET state=#{state},provider_message_id=#{messageId},error_code=#{error},next_attempt_at=now()+interval '30 seconds' WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_id=#{leaseId} AND state='SENDING'
